Chapter 593: Chapter 27: Supreme God (Subscribe Please)_2

Chapter 593: Chapter 27: Supreme God (Subscribe please)_2

But the God of Divination was too powerful, one of the twenty-four Prime Gods who were the strongest in heaven and earth. Even if he divined the secrets of Prime Gods of the same level, he basically did not have to pay much of a price.

Because of this, the vast majority of True Gods had forgotten that exercise of the ‘divination’ authority came with a cost.

“What exactly is the origin of the Longshan Patriarch that made the God of Divination pay such a price?”

“Could it have something to do with the legend of the ‘Supreme God’?”

“The Supreme God?”

The True Gods wore solemn expressions.

...

Since the creation of the World, when the first Prime God, the God of Light, was born, rumors of the ‘Supreme God’ had been circulating.

It was said that the ‘Supreme God’ created everything, including the ‘True God Forms’ that the Prime Gods possessed, which were also bestowed by the Supreme God.

Why is the number of Prime Gods fixed at twenty-four? It is because to become a Prime God, one must have a True God Form.

And there are only twenty-four True God Forms.

Theoretically, a new Prime God is born only when the previous one falls.

There have been several instances in history where a Prime God vanished, and shortly after, the World reconverged and produced the True God Form corresponding to that Prime God.

Swish.

As the True Gods were communicating with each other, the God of Divination, whose aura and divine body had both plummeted to the bottom, barely held on.

“What is that?”

The God of Divination’s gaze carried a trace of fear.

He had used the method of time reversal, attempting to pinpoint the origin of the Longshan Patriarch, but in the end, he saw no useful scenes, and it was only now that he was recovering from the backlash that had struck him down.

“The Supreme God?”

The God of Divination also immediately thought of the Supreme God.

He had never seen the Supreme God, but under the current circumstances, the backlash that he suffered could only be explained by the legendary ‘Supreme God’ other than which the God of Divination could think of no other explanation.

“The Longshan Patriarch actually obtained an opportunity related to the Supreme God?”

The God of Divination took a deep breath; he did not believe that the Longshan Patriarch was the Supreme God, because if that were true, none of what had happened earlier would have occurred.

Given the status of the Supreme God, a single command would have made even them, Prime Gods, obediently comply, so how could it be possible for demigods to still be abducted among humans?

“An opportunity related to the Supreme God…” A hint of longing flashed in the depths of the God of Divination’s eyes.

…

Longshan Ling.

The many members of the Longshan Family had also received the news. Over the years, the Longshan Family’s influence had radiated throughout the entire Plateau of Myriad Nations, starting from Longshan Ling.

Naturally, they had made many demigod acquaintances.

And a large part of these demigods were connected to True Gods from the Ocean of Light.

Thus, it was quickly passed to the Longshan Family that the divine incarnations of hundreds of True Gods, who descended, were all slain by the hands of the Longshan Patriarch.

“The Patriarch killed the incarnations of hundreds of True Gods?”

Many of the Longshan Family elders were shocked. They had watched the Longshan Family grow step by step from being a Viscount power to what it was today.

Even the longevity the elders enjoyed was a gift from the Patriarch.

However, no matter how much these family elders admired their own Patriarch, when they learned that the incarnations of lofty True Gods seemed like ants before Lin Yuan, they were staggered.

How could this be possible?

Wasn’t it said that everything beneath True Gods were mere ants?

Why were True Gods now the ants?

“My son, has he become a god?” Longshan Fang asked dazedly, his understanding being not so high, not clear that ascending to godhood and lifting Divine Kingdom could not be hidden at all.

But if Longshan Yuan could kill hundreds of divine incarnations so easily, the only possibility was that he had also become a god himself.

“Ayuan…” Longshan Fang’s wife also looked incredulous, she still remembered Longshan Yuan as the good-for-nothing playboy from before, now to have reached such lofty heights.

“The Patriarch has not become a god.”

Longshan Ling took the initiative to speak out.

That was information revealed by the Rank Pope, and likely not false.

Moreover, any strong being who ascended to godhood must enter the Ocean of Light or the Dark Abyss at the first chance, which was an ironclad rule among the gods.

But now, the Longshan Patriarch was still residing in the cultivation hall of the Great Hall.

“Not a god?”

The many members of the Longshan Family looked at each other in bewilderment.

Most of them were not clear about the significance of what had transpired, but their reverence and admiration for the Patriarch instantly deepened.

…

Ocean of Light.

The Great Hall of the Gods.

Upon the twenty-four thrones, silhouettes appeared one after another.

These figures were all Prime Gods, not only including those from the Ocean of Light but also those from the Dark Abyss were converging.

Though the factions of the Ocean of Light and the Dark Abyss were different, and numerous divine wars had occurred over the course of countless years,

such matters were for the True Gods beneath the Prime Gods. In the eyes of the Prime Gods, there was no difference between the Ocean of Light and the Dark Abyss.

The twenty-four Prime Gods essentially existed on the same level of life, and there was no hatred among them that couldn’t be dissolved.

At this moment, faced with an opportunity related to the Supreme God, they gathered one after the other.

“Divination, is the Longshan Patriarch truly related to the Supreme God?” said a figure shrouded in darkness solemnly, he was the Dark God.

He was the second Prime God born in this world; while the Ocean of Light was created by the Prime God of Light, the Dark Abyss was created by him.

“If it wasn’t related to the Supreme God, how would I have fallen into such a predicament?” the God of Divination replied weakly.

Even if barely resisting the backlash, the God of Divination was drained of his endowment, with his Divine Kingdom on the verge of collapse.

Such loss would take a million years to recover from.

“Indeed,”

the Dark God’s eyes flickered, and he said no more.

“What level is the Longshan Patriarch at now?” At that moment, a figure shrouded in endless light spoke up.

“I can confirm that the Longshan Patriarch is still a ninth-level being. The backlash didn’t come from him,” the God of Divination quickly replied.

“The Longshan Patriarch’s strength is greater than any of us here,” said the Goddess of the Magic Web with a cold gaze.

Not long ago, she had descended in an incarnation, attempting to communicate with the Longshan Patriarch, only to be obliterated with a mere gesture from him.

Through this brief encounter, the Goddess of the Magic Web vaguely gauged the Longshan Patriarch’s strength.

“As long as he has not completely surpassed the ninth level, we can talk about it.” A Prime God with an ethereal form spoke, his gaze sweeping over the other twenty-three Prime Gods, “My fellow deities, how shall we deal with the Longshan Patriarch?”

Upon these words,

the twenty-three Prime Gods exchanged glances, remaining silent.

The twenty-four Prime Gods had lived for countless years, with even their emotions worn away to a mere fraction, but at this moment, they felt a rekindled hunger.

A hunger for an opportunity related to the Supreme God.

It might help them take a step further, to rise above the other Prime Gods.

Then, there would be no distinction between the Ocean of Light and the Dark Abyss in this world.

“You wish to deal with that Longshan Patriarch, to seize the opportunity related to the Supreme God?” The God of Divination understood the intentions of the Prime Gods.

In fact, he harbored the same aspiration, for who wouldn’t want to advance further? But considering the current state of the God of Divination, it was merely wishful thinking.

“In dealing with the Longshan Patriarch, we must exercise extreme caution. Do not forget, he resides in the human realm. Even if we join forces, we might not seize the opportunity related to the Supreme God, and instead shatter the human realm,” another Prime God spoke up.

Whether it be the chance of the Supreme God or the possibility of advancing,

the myriad beings of the human realm are the foundation of the Prime Gods.

“Right,”

“We need to find a pretext to lure the Longshan Patriarch into the Ocean of Light or the Dark Abyss,”

The other Prime Gods nodded slightly, aware that only in the deep recesses of the Ocean of Light or the Dark Abyss, layered by numerous Spatial Layers, could they act without restraint.

…..

Longshan Ling.

The Longshan Great Hall.

Lin Yuan was still in closed-door cultivation, comprehending the Demigod Lattice.

[Your aptitude defies the heavens, observing the nature of the world’s rules, your understanding of space continues to rise…]

…

[Your aptitude defies the heavens, observing the nature of the world’s rules, your understanding of space continues to rise…]

…

[Your aptitude defies the heavens, observing the nature of the world’s rules, your understanding of space continues to rise…]

…

Accompanying the vast insights merging into his heart, a qualitative change finally occurred, and Lin Yuan suddenly came to an enlightenment, fully comprehending the basic facet of the spatial essence of this world.

“So that’s how it is.”

Lin Yuan opened his eyes, his gaze profound.

Simultaneously,

his Inner World began to undergo earth-shattering changes.
